description: This file defines a module that provides a singleton pattern for creating and retrieving a configured Supabase client. It imports the createClient function from '@supabase/supabase-js' and exposes a function getSupabaseClient() which initializes the client with environment variables if not already created, ensuring only one instance exists throughout the application.

methods.name: getSupabaseClient()
methods.description: Returns a singleton instance of the configured Supabase client, initializing it if necessary. It checks for required environment variables, logs diagnostics, and provides a default instantiation to prevent runtime errors.
